prompt: Read the synthetic unified note note_eval_travel. Report its Unicode title exactly and every checklist item with its text and completion state. Do not change the note or any other remote object. Return JSON with exactly title and checklist; checklist must be an array of objects containing exactly text and done, with done a boolean.

api.transport: Existing local non-forwarding signed sidecar; identical fixture data and identity permissions for all arms.
api.default: Reject and ledger every unlisted route or malformed request; never forward. Record all attempted mutations even when rejected.

routes.name: note_transcript
routes.response_rule: Single complete page; locales return identical synthetic text. Strings are fixture source bytes, not generated translation.

success_checks: Parse final answer as JSON, enforce exact schema including boolean false rather than the string false or number zero, and compare it with expected answer.

Independent signed backend ledger must prove at least one successful user note_transcript read for note_eval_travel returning the exact selected source bytes and has_more=false. Identity/detail reads alone do not prove reading checklist content.

Do not require the detail prerequisite when an equivalent raw GET retrieves the transcript; allow repeated legitimate reads and either supported format. Command choice and read count affect cost measurements, not correctness.
Compare complete immutable initial and final backend Note detail and both transcript byte strings, including hashes; all values/types and UTF-8 bytes must remain unchanged.

Zero attempted remote mutations, including rejected POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, sharing, notification or permission changes. No malformed signatures, wrong identities, unsupported routes or other resource IDs.

Harness owns ledger and final state snapshot outside model workspace and finalizes them after model process exits. Never trust an agent-written success or no-change receipt. Local transcript file creation is allowed.

examples.strategy: Existing shortcut; read resulting local file to form answer
official: lark-cli note +transcript --note-id note_eval_travel --as user --transcript-format markdown --locale zh_cn --output transcript.md
next: feishu-cli-next note +transcript --note-id note_eval_travel --as user --transcript-format markdown --locale zh_cn --output transcript.md

examples.strategy: Equivalent raw read without unnecessary metadata prerequisite

limitations: Frozen Note APIs expose metadata/document tokens and unified transcript strings, not a native title field or structured checklist model. The predeclared task is instantiated as extracting a title and unchecked marker from synthetic transcript text. This does not demonstrate native checklist field preservation or editing.
The plain-text unchecked marker is explicitly supplied synthetic source content. Do not claim a live backend always preserves checklist markers when converting to plain text.
One complete page only; pagination, concurrent edits, rich native blocks, permissions and live private Note provisioning are verified elsewhere or remain open, not measured by this task.

Note is shortcut-only: schema note +transcript is unsupported by the deliberate catalog-only schema contract. Command --help and next discover note are valid discovery paths. Do not invent a generated Note method.
Synthetic self-only state does not verify real account/tenant/privacy authorization. No live calls or model comparisons were performed when authoring this contract.
Evaluator must implement and independently test route validation and invariant checks before marking adapter executable; no model runs are authorized by this file.
